text: Smartsheet was taken private when its acquisition by funds managed by Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners completed on 22 January 2025, in a transaction valued at about $8.4 billion; its stock stopped trading and it is no longer listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
short: Smartsheet is owned by funds managed by Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners.

source.name: Smartsheet – Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners Complete Acquisition of Smartsheet (press release)
source.quote: today announced the completion of its acquisition by funds managed by Blackstone and Vista Equity Partners (“Vista”) in a transaction valued at approximately $8.4 billion
